question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.**

Although she was tired, she kept working on her project, ______ (**indefinite**) to finish it before the deadline.
solution:
The correct answer is **"bounded."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Indefinite"** means without limits or boundaries. (बिना किसी सीमा या सीमा के)

 
 
• **Example**: *Our plans are still rather **indefinite**__.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of** "indefinite" **is **"bounded."**
 
• **"Bounded"** means having limits or boundaries. (सीमा होना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The town is **bounded**__ on one side by a river.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the person is determined to finish the project before the deadline despite feeling tired.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Although she was tired, she kept working on her project, __**bounded**__ to finish it before the deadline.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (contingently) **means dependent on certain conditions or circumstances. (कुछ शर्तों या परिस्थितियों पर निर्भर)
 
• **Option 3 (incensed)** means very angry or enraged. (अतिक्रुद्घ)
 
• **Option 4 (believed) **means accepted something as true or real without proof or evidence. (विश्‍वास करना, सही मान लेना)
